skill.name: paywall-upgrade-cro

content.value_statement: In-app upgrade prompts often lose users when timing, value, or trust signals are unclear. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code design better paywalls, copy, flows, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Design feature gate, usage limit, trial expiration, soft prompt, and team upgrade paywalls.
Draft paywall copy with headlines, body text, calls to action, and dismiss options.
Recommend timing, frequency caps, and exit paths for in-product upgrade prompts.
Plan A/B tests for trigger timing, layout, pricing presentation, copy, and trial structure.
Define funnel metrics such as impressions, click-through, upgrade completion, revenue, churn, and time to upgrade.
Identify dark patterns and trust risks in upgrade flows.
limitations: It cannot analyze live product analytics unless the user provides data.
It does not guarantee revenue lift or choose final prices without business context.
It does not implement checkout, billing, or app store subscription systems.
It needs product model, user journey, pricing, and paywall trigger details for precise recommendations.

use_cases.title: Improve Free Plan Conversion
use_cases.description: Create a usage-limit paywall that explains the limit, shows the paid value, and keeps a respectful free-plan path.

use_cases.title: Plan Paywall Experiments
use_cases.description: Build a focused A/B testing plan for copy, timing, layout, pricing display, and trial offers.

use_cases.title: Design Upgrade Screen UX
use_cases.description: Turn an upgrade moment into clear screen content, layout notes, mobile behavior, and exit options.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Paywall
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one upgrade screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a feature gate paywall for [product]. The user is trying to access [paid feature]. Include the trigger, screen copy, CTA, dismiss option, and trust signals.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Screen
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using current copy or screenshots.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this upgrade screen for [product]: [paste current copy or describe screen]. Improve the headline, body copy, CTA, pricing clarity, and exit path while avoiding dark patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Experiment Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A/B test plan for our [feature gate or trial expiration] paywall. Include hypotheses, variants, target segments, primary metric, guardrail metrics, and success criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Full Upgrade Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a complete paywall-to-payment journey.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design the full upgrade flow for [product model]. Cover trigger timing, paywall screen, plan selection, checkout handoff, success state, frequency rules, mobile notes, and measurement plan.

output_examples.input: A SaaS user reaches the free project limit after creating three projects.
output_examples.output: A usage-limit paywall with a progress indicator, a clear Pro benefit, an Upgrade to Pro CTA, and a secondary option to delete a project.

output_examples.input: A trial user has three days left and has used collaboration features.
output_examples.output: A trial expiration screen that summarizes completed work, lists features they will lose, explains billing terms, and offers remind later and downgrade paths.

output_examples.input: A team admin invites a second teammate on a solo plan.
output_examples.output: A team upgrade prompt that explains seat pricing, shared project value, admin controls, and a continue solo alternative.

best_practices: Show upgrade prompts after users experience value, not during early onboarding.
Pair every hard gate with a clear reason, a value preview, and a respectful exit path.
Measure both conversion lift and trust signals such as churn, dismissals, and support complaints.
anti_patterns: Hiding close buttons, downgrade paths, cancellation details, or subscription terms.
Using misleading urgency, guilt-based copy, or surprise charges to force upgrades.
Repeating prompts too often after users dismiss them.

faq.question: What products is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for SaaS, mobile apps, freemium products, usage-based products, and per-seat subscription tools.

faq.question: Can it replace a public pricing page audit?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on in-product upgrade moments after users have experienced value.

faq.question: What inputs improve the recommendations?
faq.answer: Provide the trigger, current screen copy, pricing model, user segment, product value moment, and conversion metrics.

faq.question: Does it support mobile paywalls?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes mobile guidance for full-screen paywalls, tap targets, subscription terms, and restore purchase expectations.

faq.question: Can it create A/B test ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose tests for timing, trigger type, layout, copy, trial design, pricing presentation, and frequency caps.

faq.question: Does it encourage aggressive conversion tactics?
faq.answer: No. It explicitly warns against dark patterns, misleading urgency, hidden exits, and data hostage tactics.
